name: nft-second-chain-drops
description: a second output chain at higher priority drops what the first accepted
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
nft add chain inet f out2 "{ type filter hook output priority 10; policy accept; }"

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out2 ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
